description: Every framework plugin that is planned but not built yet. Built plugins are found from their plugin@1 manifests (apps/*/plugins/<folder>/plugin.json), so an entry here turns to built by itself once a plugin with the same id exists. Installed = built and enabled in the app looking at the list. Check: node framework/cli/plugins.mjs --check
